module.Title: Pass Information Into a Method
module.Teaching: A parameter is an input variable declared inside a method's parentheses.
module.PredictionExplanation: The caller supplies a value, and the method receives it through the amount parameter.
module.DebugPrompt: A parameter declaration needs a data type before its name.
module.RecallPrompt: Write AddStone with an int amount parameter. Use the exact identifier stoneCount.
module.TransferPrompt: Create TakeDamage with an int amount parameter. Use the exact identifier playerHealth.
